label: r4c1
name: r3c2 + 32 minibatches
hypothesis: This stacks the two best single changes: lr 3e-3 (0.81) and 32 minibatches (0.77 at lr 1e-3). Twice as many gradient steps at the high lr should speed up how fast the mixture commits and how far the policy refines, so dev should land above 0.81. Dev below about 0.6 would mean that combining a large lr with many small batches destabilises PPO.
